description: This file defines the Campaign class in PHP, representing a campaign entity within the SuiteCRM system. The class includes properties for campaign fields, relationships, and methods for handling campaign data, relationships, queries, and interactions within the application.

classes.name: Campaign
classes.description: Represents a marketing campaign within the SuiteCRM system. Provides properties for campaign data fields and methods for managing campaign information, relationships, queries, and notifications.

methods.name: list_view_parse_additional_sections
methods.description: Parses additional sections for the list view, especially resolving the assigned user's full name.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the campaign's name as its summary text.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds an SQL query for exporting campaign data, including joins and filters.

methods.name: clear_campaign_prospect_list_relationship
methods.description: Removes relationships between a campaign and prospect lists.

methods.name: mark_relationships_deleted
methods.description: Marks campaign relationships as deleted by clearing prospect list relationships.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Fills in additional list view fields, extending parent functionality.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Fills in additional detail view fields, with placeholders for optional formatting.

methods.name: update_currency_id
methods.description: Stub for updating the currency ID related to the campaign.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data for list views, including icons and links.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Creates a WHERE clause for search queries based on a provided string.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the campaign, including conversion of amounts to USDollar if applicable.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Deletes the campaign, clearing associated contacts, accounts, and logs.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Assigns campaign details to an email template for notifications.

methods.name: track_log_leads
methods.description: Retrieves campaign log entries related to leads.

methods.name: track_log_entries
methods.description: Retrieves campaign log entries with optional filtering by marketing ID and grouping.

methods.name: get_queue_items
methods.description: Retrieves queued items related to the campaign, filtering optionally by marketing ID.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates that this class implements ACL interface for access control.

methods.name: create_list_count_query
methods.description: Overrides default to handle distinct count queries for each campaign.

methods.name: getDeletedCampaignLogLeadsCount
methods.description: Counts the deleted leads associated with this campaign.
